brief: orchestration/NEXT-DISPATCH.md §0 — province streamer is never pumped from the fixed step
outputs_expected: game/src/world/province.js radiusTiles/skinRadiusM/tileM as instance fields (consumption knobs)
outputs_written: game/src/world/province.js: tileM/radiusTiles/skinRadiusM fields + one-tile release hysteresis
findings: load average at start 24.62 on four cores — HIGH. All wall-clock numbers below were taken under that.
boot-check PASS before any change.

BASELINE REPRODUCED (camera 3 km, 600 fixed steps, nothing teleports): ring_built 0/25, ring_unbuilt 25, ground_underfoot_built false, tilesBuiltTotal stayed at 25 for the whole 600 frames. NOTE the critic's 'tilesResident 0' is really 'zero of the 25 tiles that should be resident AT THE CAMERA'; tilesResident reads 25 because Lilmoth's ring is still resident 3 km behind. Same defect, sharper number.
BASELINE step cost, camera3km, 600 steps: mean 0.7275 ms/step, worst single step 28.83 ms (frame 45).

BASELINE WALKED (walkRoute crossing, stream:false, 3 km): ground_underfoot_built goes FALSE by ~750 m and stays false; 20 of 30 samples have no ground built under the player; ring 0/25 by 2.3 km; all four discs (skin/near/cover/focus) lag up to 2182.73 m.
BASELINE walking step cost: 0.116-0.230 ms/frame (mean over 3000-frame chunks).

All four camera-following layers hang off request(): province.skinAtPos (11 m hysteresis), nearAtPos (22 m), coverAt (14 m), sigLights. Each has its OWN internal distance gate, so calling request() often is cheap.

Both stepping paths call Engine._afterStep(): stepFrames() (engine.js:3209) and the rAF accumulator; walkRoute/walkPath/travelRide also call stepOnce()+_afterStep() per frame. So _afterStep() is the one slot that covers every way the world advances.
_afterStep() is OUTSIDE armSim(), so building geometry there is legal under the determinism guard; province.js contains no Math.random/Date.now/performance.now.
tools/harness/viewpoints-province.json names anchor states region_blackwood etc. which DO NOT EXIST in game/data/states — a separate defect, not fixed here.

FIX: Engine._streamProvince() in _afterStep(). Refocus every 2 m of movement; build 1 queued tile per 30 frames; build 2/frame while the nearest missing tile is within the 3x3 around the focus (queue[0].d <= 2). Focus = camera override eye if one is posed, else the player.
AFTER, critic baseline (camera 3 km, 600 fixed steps): ring_built 25/25, ring_unbuilt 0 (was 0/25 and 25), all four disc lags 0 m (were 3000 m).

AFTER, WALKED 3 km (4099 m of path, no teleport after load) + 600 more fixed steps: ring 25/25, unbuilt 0, ground underfoot TRUE, tilesBuiltTotal 145 (25 at load + 120 streamed in while walking). Disc lags: skin 0.63 m, near 6.63 m, cover 0.63 m.

SECOND DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: request() released a tile the instant it left the build ring. Harmless when it only ran on a teleport; a thrash from the fixed step. A body oscillating on a tile EDGE flipped tx0 back and forth and released+rebuilt a 5-tile row each time. Measured: 30 tile builds for 26.9 m of movement, 92 of 30,000 steps over one 60 Hz frame. Fixed with one tile of release hysteresis (KEEP = radiusTiles + 1).
The straight-line-bearing budget walk from Lilmoth at 189 deg walks into the Topal Bay (26.9 m in 30,000 frames). The budget probe now follows the crossing road spline instead.

CROSSING WALKED END TO END (run 1): 55.1 min, 6615 m, 34 samples, ground underfoot built on EVERY sample, worst ring_unbuilt 1 of 25 (the outer trickle, 600-750 m out, behind the fog in all 13 regions). Region sequence crossed valus-ridge -> stone-forest -> western-rootlands -> eastern-rootlands.

DELETE-THE-FIX (shadow tree, ONLY the this._streamProvince() call site removed, identical 1999.4 m walk): 0 tiles built (vs 30), ring 0/25 (vs 25/25), near 3x3 ring 9 of 9 UNBUILT (vs 0), all four discs 1453 m behind. The tiles go straight back to unbuilt.

FRAME BUDGET, identical 1999.4 m walks, 60,000 steps each, load 4.5-6.7: with fix mean 0.2674 ms, p50 0.05, p99 0.32, p999 66.82, max 133.8, 194 steps over 16.7 ms (0.32%); fix deleted mean 0.0618 ms, p50 0.05, p99 0.185, p999 1.625, max 14.93, 0 steps over 16.7 ms.

COST COMPOSITION per 2 km (attributed by identity-comparing the disc anchor arrays across each step): ground skin + cover disc rebuilt together 145 frames at 59.31 ms mean; near-prop disc 69 frames at 2.71 ms; tile build 30 frames at 69.18 ms. NO frame did a disc rebuild AND a tile build — the one-unit-of-work-per-step guard holds.

THE SKIN AND THE COVER DISC CANNOT BE SPLIT: updateSkin() sets this.coverAt = null on purpose, because the ground cover stands ON the skin surface and a stale cover disc sits 0.3 m inside a berm. So skin+cover is one indivisible ~59 ms unit, fired every ~13.8 m by SKIN_REBUILD_M = 11. THAT IS THE RESIDUAL COST AND I DID NOT CLOSE IT — it is W1-01 territory (updateSkin builds 15,625 vertices) and reducing it means either making updateSkin cheaper or moving W1-01s calibrated rebuild distance, which moves the picture.
next_step: finish consumption arms, night walk, final boot-check
notes_for_successor: Probe is tools/world/prov-stream.mjs. It reads window.__ENGINE read-only and NEVER calls request/pump/drain/streamAround — that is deliberate, the harness's own streamAround is why this defect survived. --tile-radius / --skin-radius perturb the streamer for RI-MTH07 consumption.
